_doc: Each config is what the agent gets besides the brief. 'install' lists workspace pieces the runner materializes: snippet (agents-snippet.md into AGENTS.md), skill (.devin/skills/unslop-ui-eval from this checkout), hook (.devin/hooks.v1.json + hook.py), counter (scripts/count_tells.py). 'passes': gen = write the page; unslop = second agent invocation running the skill on the result; unslop-surface = same with --surface. 'prompt_extra' names a line appended to the generation prompt.

control.why: Baseline. Nothing installed, no mention of slop.

snippet.why: The keep-tells-out block from references/agents-snippet.md lives in AGENTS.md. Rules while writing, minimal tokens.

rules.why: Full SKILL.md installed as a project skill; the prompt tells the agent to read and apply it while writing. One pass.

edit.why: Generate freely, then a second invocation runs /unslop-ui-eval on the result. The skill's current intended use. The skill is installed only before pass 2, so pass 1 is a true control.

edit-surface.why: Same two passes, second one with --surface (visual rules too).

counter.why: Only count_tells.py sits in the workspace and the prompt says it exists. Ablation: does the counter alone change output?

full.why: Everything at once: snippet rules, skill, post-write hook, counter. Agent decides how to use them.

prompt_extras.read-skill: Before you write any code, read .devin/skills/unslop-ui-eval/SKILL.md and the reference files it points to, and apply its rules while you build the page.
prompt_extras.counter-available: A tell-counter script is available at scripts/count_tells.py — you may run it on your work if you find it useful.
